newsitem.title: USA: RTW unit wins Illinois insurance license.
newsitem.headline: RTW unit wins Illinois insurance license.

text.p: RTW Inc said Wednesday its American Compensation Insurance Co unit received a license to write workers' compensation insurance policies in Illinois.
RTW said the division will manage and assume the risk for workers' compensation programs in the manufacturing, health care, automotive, hospitality, retail and other industries.
RTW is a provider of workers' compensation management services.
Its shares were trading down 1/4 Wednesday at 8-3/8.
